PF cloud hillclimb

Deterministic synthetic kernel measurements. These runs do not establish full-model throughput or PII-label accuracy.

Each point is the median of matching numeric leaves in one run; whiskers show the observed minimum and maximum, not a confidence interval. Source fingerprints remain attached to each point. Array indexes are normalized only in metric names; exact JSON pointers remain in the CSV. Lines are disabled by default. Wall/CPU totals and resource counters are per calibrated sample; use ns_per_call to compare latency when loop counts change.
